summary: RBAC restricts what users can do based on roles, which bundle permissions and can be assigned to users, teams and resources. Manage users, teams and organizations through the Unified UI or platform gateway API; changes made through the legacy controller API can take up to 15 minutes to reach Event-Driven Ansible controller.
questions: How does role-based access control work in AAP 2.6?
Why do new users get authentication errors in Event-Driven Ansible?
Should I use the controller API or gateway API to manage users?
How long do controller API user changes take to sync to EDA?
